metadata.description: Panels, guardrails and quality-of-life mods for Claude Code, built on function hooks.

plugins.name: mod-manager
plugins.description: Start here: one panel (/mods) to install, turn on or off, update, or remove each claude-mod, with presets.

plugins.name: quickbar
plugins.description: One-line launcher above the prompt: live context % and buttons for every claude-mods panel.

plugins.name: context-keeper
plugins.description: Context-window panel: what fills it, handoff checkpoints before compact/clear, transcript archive, early warnings.

plugins.name: usage-meter
plugins.description: Plan-limit bars with burn rate and time-to-empty, session cost, cache hit ratio, tokens-per-turn sparkline.

plugins.name: notify
plugins.description: Notification inbox + native OS notifications for long turns, finished subagents/background tasks and pending approvals.

plugins.name: activity
plugins.description: Live view of what Claude runs and waits for: tools with real commands and timers, approvals, subagents, todo plan.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Clickable safety rules and presets: block rm -rf, force-push, secrets, installs, network; lock to project; read-only; custom patterns.

plugins.name: prompt-coach
plugins.description: Suggests a sharper rewrite of vague prompts before sending; you choose send improved, send yours, or edit.

plugins.name: toolbox
plugins.description: All tools Claude can use in plain language, usage counts, and suggestions tailored to your project.

plugins.name: command-hub
plugins.description: Discover, search and create slash commands, with plain-language explanations and contextual tips.

plugins.name: changes
plugins.description: Files Claude changed this session with +/- counts and one-click why/summary/self-review.

plugins.name: loop-breaker
plugins.description: Detects Claude going in circles (same failing command, same file patched repeatedly) and nudges it to rethink.
